name: The St. Regis Hong Kong
insider_take: This towering luxury sanctuary sits at the epicenter of Hong Kong's financial district, where East meets West in spectacular fashion 129 floors above the bustling streets.
whats_special: The St. Regis Hong Kong occupies floors 112-129 of the International Commerce Centre (ICC) - Hong Kong's tallest building. The hotel's signature Ritz-Carlton Bar was reimagined as The Drawing Room, maintaining its status as one of the world's highest hotel bars. Each suite features floor-to-ceiling windows offering unobstructed views of Victoria Harbour, and the legendary St. Regis Butler Service ensures every detail is perfected.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-view suite on floors 125+ for the ultimate panoramic experience - you'll literally be above the clouds on misty days, watching the city emerge below.
dont_miss: The hotel's direct connection to Elements shopping mall and the Airport Express station makes it incredibly convenient, while the nearby Avenue of Stars waterfront promenade offers the perfect vantage point to appreciate your sky-high accommodation from street level. The Symphony of Lights show at 8 PM provides a dazzling view from your suite.
pros: Legendary St. Regis butler service providing personalized attention
Prime Wan Chai location with harbor views and business district access
Luxurious accommodations with sophisticated contemporary design
Multiple dining venues including Michelin-starred cuisine options
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
